summary: The exact candidate commit is a correct narrow follow-up to an original-issue migration that was already present in the recorded base. The base already removes the legacy popular-model pages and redirects /basic_usage/popular_model_usage.html to the integrated cookbook. The candidate fixes the remaining semantic misroute for /basic_usage/qwen3.html: the deleted source page was specifically titled Qwen3-Next Usage, but the base redirected it to generic Qwen3. The candidate redirects it to the existing Qwen3-Next cookbook page and adds focused static regression coverage. This is not a standalone implementation of the full original feature; it is a valid partial fix plus hardening on top of the previously merged full migration.
